name: Md Nazim Uddin Noyon
headline: The technical side of going live.
intro: I’m Noyon, a broadcast engineer working behind the scenes of esports. I bring live production, backend workflows, and automation together to keep the show running smoothly.
bio: I specialize in esports backend production, stream operations, overlays, production control, observer integration, and live broadcast management—with a strong focus on Free Fire tournaments. I combine broadcast operations with programming and data tools to make production workflows stable, repeatable, and easier to operate under pressure.

experience.description: Leading esports live-production backend operations, with a primary focus on Free Fire tournament workflows and production reliability.
Managed live stream setup, overlays, backend production workflows, and technical broadcast support for esports events.
Built hands-on experience with streaming tools, scene control, graphics workflows, and backend coordination in community esports production.

skills.name: Broadcast
skills.description: Live production setup, input management, switching, overlays, and stream operations.

skills.name: Development
skills.description: Programming for production tools, backend utilities, and the web.

skills.name: Data & Automation
skills.description: Repeatable workflows, production data, and less repetitive work behind the scenes.
